GuideDialogFragment.builder(this)
	.addStep(
		view = anchor,
		content = GuideContent.Default("标题", "正文"),
		position = GuidePosition.below()
	)
	.listener(guideListener)
	.show(this)

// 其他选项
.build() / .followAnchor(false)
.dismissOnTouchOutside(true)
.dismissOnBackPress(false)
.storage(storage) / .showOnce("key")

GuideStep(
	anchor = GuideAnchor.ViewAnchor(view),
	tooltip = GuideTooltip(content = content),
	highlight = GuideHighlight(),
	followAnchor = true,
	onShown = { },
	anchorLostPolicy = AnchorLostPolicy.SKIP_NEXT,
	passThroughTargetTouch = false,
	passThroughOutsideMask = false,
	advanceOnTargetClick = false
)

// GuideEndReason
// FINISHED / SKIPPED / DISMISSED
// ANCHOR_LOST / HOST_DESTROYED

GuideAnchor.ViewAnchor(view)
GuideAnchor.RectAnchor { screenRect }
GuideAnchor.RecyclerViewItemAnchor(
	recyclerView = recycler,
	position = 7,
	childId = R.id.itemAction,
	scrollToItem = true
)

GuideTooltip(
	content = content,
	position = GuidePosition.Relative(
		side = Side.TOP, // TOP/BOTTOM/START/END/AUTO
		align = Alignment.CENTER,
		margin = 8.dp,
		offsetX = 0.dp,
		offsetY = 0.dp,
		autoOrder = listOf(
			Side.BOTTOM, Side.TOP, Side.END, Side.START
		)
	),
	maxWidth = GuideWidth.Wrap
)

// 快捷写法
GuidePosition.above() / below()
GuidePosition.startOf() / endOf()
GuidePosition.of(Side.TOP, align = Alignment.CENTER)

GuidePosition.Relative(
	side = Side.TOP,
	align = Alignment.START, // START/CENTER/END
	margin = 8.dp,
	offsetX = 0.dp,
	offsetY = 0.dp
)

maxWidth = GuideWidth.Wrap // 默认：内容自适应
maxWidth = GuideWidth.Fixed(220.dp)
maxWidth = GuideWidth.FillScreen
maxWidth = GuideWidth.FillMask // 配合 maskRectProvider

edgePadding = 16.dp

GuideTooltip(
	content = GuideContent.Default(
		title = "标题",
		message = "正文",
		titleColor = 0xFF4E342E.toInt(),
		messageColor = 0xFF6D4C41.toInt()
	),
	backgroundColor = 0xFFFFF8E1.toInt(),
	cornerRadius = 22.dp,
	strokeColor = 0xFFFFB300.toInt(),
	strokeWidth = 2.dp,
	arrow = GuideArrow(size = 14.dp, edgeInset = 18.dp)
)

// 自定义布局：两个库 ID
<LinearLayout
	android:id="@id/guide_bubble"
	android:layout_width="wrap_content"
	android:layout_height="wrap_content">
	...
</LinearLayout>

<ImageView
	android:id="@id/guide_arrow"
	android:layout_width="14dp"
	android:layout_height="18dp" />

GuideContent.CustomBinding(
	create = { inflater, parent ->
		MyGuideBinding.inflate(inflater, parent, false)
	},
	bind = { binding, session -> ... }
)

HoleShape.Rect
HoleShape.RoundRect(14.dp)
HoleShape.Circle() / Circle(16.dp)
HoleShape.Oval
HoleShape.Custom { rect, path ->
	buildStarPath(rect, path)
}

GuideHighlight(
	shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(12.dp),
	padding = 4.dp
)

GuideHighlight(
	holeRectProvider = { anchor ->
		Rect(
			anchor.centerX() - halfWidthPx,
			anchor.centerY() - halfHeightPx,
			anchor.centerX() + halfWidthPx,
			anchor.centerY() + halfHeightPx
		)
	}
)

GuideHighlight(
	shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(12.dp),
	maskColor = 0xCC1565C0.toInt(),
	holeOverlayColor = 0x33FFFFFF.toInt()
)

// 只压暗，无高亮区
shape = null
GuideStep(..., passThroughTargetTouch = true)\nGuideStep(..., advanceOnTargetClick = true)\nGuideStep(..., passThroughOutsideMask = true)

GuideDialogFragment.builder(this)
	.addStep(...)
	.storage(storage)
	.showOnce("welcome_v1")
	.show(fragmentManager)

GuideContent.Default(
 title = "标题",
 message = "正文",
 primaryLabel = "下一步",
 finishLabel = "完成",
 skipLabel = null,
 showIndicator = true,
 titleColor = null,
 messageColor = null
)

GuideArrow(
 enabled = true,
 size = 8.dp,
 edgeInset = 12.dp
)

GuideHighlight(
 shape = null,
 maskColor = 0xB3000000.toInt()
)

GuideHighlight(
 shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(12.dp),
 holeOverlayColor = 0x33FFFFFF
)

GuideHighlight(
 maskRectProvider = { _, anchor ->
 Rect(
 anchor.left - padX,
 anchor.top - padY,
 anchor.right + padX,
 anchor.bottom + padY
 )
 }
)

GuideStep(..., passThroughOutsideMask = true)
